args.script:
cat << 'EOF' > solution.sh
#!/bin/bash
# Find sum of integers in log files whose server ID is prime and created within last 7 days

is_prime() {
    local n=$1
    if [ "$n" -lt 2 ]; then return 1; fi
    if [ "$n" -eq 2 ]; then return 0; fi
    if [ $((n % 2)) -eq 0 ]; then return 1; fi
    local i=3
    while [ $((i * i)) -le "$n" ]; do
        if [ $((n % i)) -eq 0 ]; then return 1; fi
        i=$((i + 2))
    done
    return 0
}

today=$(date +%s)
sum=0

for f in log_files/*.txt; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    base=$(basename "$f")
    # Parse server ID and date from log_server_X_YYYY-MM-DD.txt
    server_id=$(echo "$base" | sed -E 's/^log_server_([0-9]+)_[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}\.txt$/\1/')
    file_date=$(echo "$base" | sed -E 's/^log_server_[0-9]+_([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})\.txt$/\1/')
    [ -z "$server_id" ] && continue
    [ -z "$file_date" ] && continue

    # Check prime
    is_prime "$server_id" || continue

    # Check within last 7 days
    file_ts=$(date -d "$file_date" +%s)
    diff=$(( (today - file_ts) / 86400 ))
    if [ "$diff" -lt 0 ] || [ "$diff" -ge 7 ]; then continue; fi

    # Add integers
    while read -r line; do
        [ -n "$line" ] && sum=$((sum + line))
    done < "$f"
done

echo "$sum"
EOF
chmod +x solution.sh
./solution.sh
